raster.basis_point_rule: start_bp = ceil(p0 * 10000 / E); end_bp = floor(p1 * 10000 / E); width_bp = end_bp - start_bp. NormalizedRoi::to_pixels floors the start and ceils the exclusive end, so the ceiled start is load-bearing: the naive deep_shadow y of 4222 resolves to y 75, h 17 = 204 pixels.

tracking.path_formula: x(f) = round(148 + 100 sin(2 pi f / 100)); y(f) = round(78 + 40 sin(2 pi f / 100))

thresholds_distinctness.note: MATTE_TRACK_DEAD_ZONE_BASIS_POINTS is 0, so distinctness from it is trivially true for every positive constant and CC7 does not assert it (minor 4).

(b1) residual spread.note: the (b1) row has its own budget, one code above the (a) match budget: the corrected C1 document measures 3 on the amended twelve-patch band, a 1.67x margin against 5 but a 2.0x margin against 6. CC7_MATCH_NEUTRAL_SPREAD_MAX_CODE could not be widened to 6, because 6 is exactly what unmatched cam B measures and a shared budget would admit (a)'s own failing direction (A15). Ruling recorded as Implementer G's resolution of erratum C-E7.

delivery, 8-bit luma mean.note: re-pinned from probe-1's pre-A1 185 059 to the worst per-scenario amended-scene measurement, 377 538 on (e): a 1.06x margin against a CC6 constant CC7 must not move (Implementer C erratum C-E8, review R4-M2). This is the one row that does not clear the 2x bar, so Cc7BudgetKind::RecordedMargin records the margin instead of asserting a ratio the slice does not have; cc7_every_budget_carries_the_declared_margin asserts that classification in both directions.

delivery, 8-bit RGB mean.note: re-pinned from probe-1's pre-A1 499 781 to the worst per-scenario amended-scene measurement, 855 810 on (e). It still clears the 2x bar, by 2.2 percent of the budget, so it stays a ratio row (R4-M2).

delivery, 8-bit PSNR.note: re-pinned from probe-1's pre-A1 4 148 to the worst per-scenario amended-scene measurement, 4 059 on (e). A floor row: the margin is a code distance, never a ratio (R4-M2).

delivery, 10-bit luma mean.note: re-pinned from probe-1's pre-A1 972 to the worst per-scenario amended-scene measurement, 347 on (e) (R4-M2).

delivery, 10-bit RGB mean.note: re-pinned from probe-1's pre-A1 199 455 to the worst per-scenario amended-scene measurement, 385 514 on (e), a 2.59x margin (R4-M2).

budgets.delivery_note: CC6 owns these constants; CC7 measures against them and never re-baselines one
budgets.delivery_measured_note: Every 'measured' figure in budgets.delivery is a Linux measurement (see budgets.measurement) and is reported, not gated: the two CI FFmpeg builds decode the same encode to different numbers, so what assert_cc7_delivery_lane gates on both operating systems is the CC6 budget bound in this row's 'budget' column, against the live measurement and against this recorded one. CC7_MEASURED_DELIVERY_EIGHT/TEN stay tied to these rows as the worst per term.

delivery_windows_observed.note: P10's measurement, first honest Windows run. These two figures are reported, not gated, and are recorded as a per-OS note rather than a per-OS constant (§14, R5). Only the two terms below were reached before the equality assertion this run replaced stopped each test; the other fifty-eight terms are still unmeasured on Windows. Both figures sit far inside their CC6 budgets. Root cause, reproduced on Linux: adding accurate_rnd to the delivery scaler flags makes the Linux 8-bit lane measure the Windows number exactly, so the MSVC build's swscale rounds chroma as if SWS_ACCURATE_RND were set; the 10-bit divergence is not reproduced by that flag and remains a separate build difference.
